raw:
[
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Glastonbury < OE Glæstingaburg; glæs (glass) + tun (enclosure) + burh (fort); 'glass-town-fort'",
    "reading": "A fortified glass enclosure, a vitreous stronghold of vision.",
    "languages": ["en", "ang"],
    "source": "Oxford English Dictionary, 'Glastonbury'",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Glas + ton + bury; glas (fr. 'glas' = bell) + ton (fr. 'ton' = sound) + bury (en. 'bury' = hide)",
    "reading": "The bell's tone is buried — a hidden resonance beneath the earth.",
    "languages": ["fr", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.7
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Glas (de. 'glass') + ton (en. 'tone') + bury (en. 'bury'); also 'glast' (en. archaic 'to shine')",
    "reading": "A shining tone interred; light sound sealed in crystal.",
    "languages": ["de", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Glastonbury -> 'Glaston' + 'bury' -> 'Bury glaston' -> 'glaston' = 'gla' (glaive) + 'ston' (stone)",
    "reading": "A stone blade that buries itself — a petrified weapon of initiation.",
    "languages": ["en", "fr"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "G-L-A-S-T-O-N-B-U-R-Y: G (gnosis) L (lux) A (aqua) S (spiritus) T (terra) O (origo) N (nous) B (benedictio) U (unio) R (regeneratio) Y (yggdrasil)",
    "reading": "Gnosis, light, water, spirit, earth, origin, mind, blessing, union, renewal, world-tree.",
    "languages": ["la", "grc", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "G (gamma) = transformation; L (lambda) = balance; A (alpha) = beginning; S (sigma) = sum; T (tau) = cross; O (omicron) = circle; N (nu) = new; B (beta) = second; U (upsilon) = vessel; R (rho) = flow; Y (ypsilon) = fork",
    "reading": "A balanced beginning summed at the cross, a new vessel flowing into a forked path.",
    "languages": ["grc"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.2
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "G(7)+L(12)+A(1)+S(19)+T(20)+O(15)+N(14)+B(2)+U(21)+R(18)+Y(25) = 154; 1+5+4=10; 1+0=1",
    "reading": "Reduces to unity — a monadic core, the singular point of all glassy reflections.",
    "languages": ["en", "he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "Glastonbury < OE Glæstingaburg; 'Glæsting' = people of Glæst (a personal name) + burh; but 'glæs' (glass) also cognate with 'glæd' (bright, glad)",
    "reading": "The bright folk's fort — a luminous community enclosed in clarity.",
    "languages": ["en", "ang"],
    "source": "Bosworth-Toller Anglo-Saxon Dictionary",
    "confidence": 0.7
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "Glas + ton + bury; 'glas' (gael. 'green') + 'ton' (en. 'town') + 'bury' (en. 'borough')",
    "reading": "Green town of the buried — a verdant crypt, a living mound.",
    "languages": ["ga", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Glastonbury ~ 'Glash-ton-bury' ; 'glash' (de. 'glash' = brittle) + 'bury' (en. 'bury')",
    "reading": "Brittle sound buried — a fragile resonance that must be unearthed with care.",
    "languages": ["de", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Glastonbury -> 'Stony Garb' + 'L' -> 'Stony' (stone) + 'Garb' (clothing) + 'L' (el = god)",
    "reading": "God's stone garment — a petrified robe of the divine.",
    "languages": ["en", "he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "G-L-A-S-T-O-N-B-U-R-Y: 'Gloria Lucis Aqua Spiritus Terra Origo Novum Benedictum Unio Regnum Y'",
    "reading": "Glory of light, water, spirit, earth — origin of new blessed union, kingdom of Y.",
    "languages": ["la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.2
  }
]
